remarks: Your own outdoor retreat awaits at 1 Arch Street. This thoughtfully designed first-floor studio features a private deck and fenced, landscaped yard, offering a welcoming setting for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or unwinding at the end of the day.  Inside, ceilings over 9 feet, black shiplap-style accents, and an exposed steel beam create an airy space with distinctive industrial character. High-end lighting throughout highlights the architectural details, while warm wood-look flooring provides an inviting contrast. The open layout includes a defined sleeping area and room to relax, work, and entertain, with a ceiling fan and wall-mounted mini-split A/C for added comfort.  The separate full kitchen features white cabinetry, a subway tile backsplash, ample counter space, and a full-size range and refrigerator. Built-ins throughout offer practical storage, while a walk-in closet with in-unit laundry adds everyday convenience.  The beautifully updated bathroom brings a touch of luxury with a frameless glass walk-in shower, large-format tile, a built-in shower niche, dual showerheads, and modern lighting.  Distinctive architectural details, thoughtful amenities, and private outdoor living make this studio a standout.
